integrity: Exact coefficient identities for cycles of sizes three through six; proof of the all-size obstruction via a derived closed-form pseudoinverse of the cycle Laplacian. The sharp six-cycle root is certified by Descartes sign variation and sign continuity; its negative witness is exact rational. Finite checker corroborates but is not substituted for the proof over all sizes.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the unweighted periodic one-dimensional nearest-neighbor Markov generator on simple cycles. For sizes at least seven it proves eventual large-step negativity, not a complete interval classification. The sharp complete interval is proved only for the six-cycle. Exact arithmetic and end-step positivity, not Runge–Kutta stage positivity or floating-point behavior.
title: Six-cycle threshold and all-size positivity dichotomy for fourth-order Gauss diffusion
